'''2012 European Championship Chris Menzel DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
